name: Wild Haven
detailed_description:
Wild Haven is a 4x nature builder about a small spirit rebuilding a polluted world. Explore the world around you, clean up the pollution left behind, bring back plants and animals, and grow your woodland forest. Unlock your full potential by helping ancient spirits and selecting upgrades to build a vibrant ecosystem.

Build complex ecosystems

Build your forest and discover unique and varied wildlife.  Strategically place wildlife on the map to act as resources for other kinds of plants and animals.  As you build more, you’ll be able to add more resource intensive plants and animals. Upgrade your own abilities to discover new and interesting wildlife and see what kind of forest you can build.

Explore and clean

With each run, explore the changed landscape of your forest. Clean up toxic spills and polluted waters and repurpose or break down abandoned buildings. Some messes can take longer to clean up than others and some pollution may try to spread, damaging existing wildlife!

Awaken the spirits of the woods

Discover the spirits of the woods and grow your own powers. With each run, you may discover older spirits of the woods that are struggling in the toxic world.  Help them with quests to learn their story and gain their favor to unlock new upgrades of your own.

Multiple map sizes and game modes

Select from different map sizes: small, normal or large depending on how long you want your run to last.  A small map can be completed in 45 mins while a larger map can take multiple hours.  With each run you can choose between different modes. 

In Classic mode, you will have a fixed number of turns to build your forest up. Use your resources wisely before you run out of time and see how well you did. For a more relaxing play through, in One More Turn mode, you’ll have an unlimited number of turns to build the forest as you see fit. When you are happy with your efforts end your run and take a snapshot to share your forest with others!

A procedural generated land

Each time you start a run you will be dropped into a new landscape meaning no two runs will ever be the same. You’ll find spirits that have different quests and a different story to tell.  Evolve your strategy as you explore and make decisions on what kind of forest you’ll build.

short_description: A twist on the 4X genre! Explore a ruined world, clean up the polluted land, build up your forest home and create a thriving nature ecosystem. Strategically place plants and animals, discover hidden powers and rebuild the forest your way!

  • Storage: 200 MB available space
